summary: A hybrid Edge-Cloud AI Assistant extension (Chrome/Safari) implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Composio Toolset, and a sophisticated Multi-Agent System (MAS). It features a 3D Agent Network Visualizer (Three.js), a GPU-accelerated Compute Engine (WebGPU/WGSL), and a robust Communication Fabric. The system dynamically offloads tasks between local hardware (Gemini Nano, WebGPU) and cloud endpoints (Abacus.AI, OpenAI, Composio). It includes a Python-based Deep Research CLI, specialized GitHub context extraction, and an @mention command system for invoking 250+ external tools. The architecture enforces a strict Edge-Cloud Continuum for state continuity and privacy, utilizing a specialized ContextExtractor with caching and a split Vite/Webpack build system.

architecture.style: Hybrid Edge-Cloud Extension + React SPA + Multi-Agent System + Swift Host App
key_components: Composio Integration Layer (@mention Tool Routing & Parsing via MentionParser)
Agent Registry (Discovery, Health Monitoring, Load Balancing)
Communication Fabric (Pub/Sub, Shared Memory, Dead Letter Queue)
State Continuity Fabric (Differential Sync, Cloud-Based Context Access)
Reasoning Engine (Plan, Decompose, Infer, Hypothesize, Decide)
Context Extraction Layer (ContextExtractor: Metadata, Content, Selection, 5s Cache)
Distributed Knowledge Graph (Page Visits, User Context, Entity Linking)
Deep Research Module (Python REST API + CLI + Caching)
Safari Host Application (Swift Bridge for macOS/iOS)
UI Layer (Floating Bubble, Injected Panel, Popup Interface, AI Avatar Coach Overlay)

conventions: Manifest V3 compliance (Service Workers, ActiveTab, Scripting)
Build process via Split Vite/Webpack (Vite for UI/Overlay, Webpack for Extension Core)
Consolidated build output in 'dist/' with subdirectories (debug, manual, pack, simple, test)
Centralized asset management in 'dist/assets/' with automated manifest path adjustment during pack
Strict TypeScript configuration (ES2020/2022 target)
Tailwind CSS for styling (PostCSS config)
Proxy network requests via background script to bypass CORS
Use chrome.storage.local/sync for user configuration and profiles
Use IndexedDB for persistent message queuing, agent state, and Knowledge Graph
Use SharedArrayBuffer for zero-copy inter-agent communication where supported
Implement 'Code Agents' via Smolagents for executable logic
Integrate Composio for external tool execution via @mention syntax
Prioritize Abacus.AI for reasoning tasks, fallback to OpenAI, then Local
Use custom WGSL shaders for hardware-accelerated matrix/attention operations
Visualize agent topology and message flow using Three.js
Inject MCP sidebar/panel into pages for context-aware actions
Automated ZIP packaging via GitHub Actions on tag push
Privacy-first context sharing (User Consent & Boundaries)
Prefer Local AI (Gemini Nano/WebNN) for low-latency/high-privacy tasks
Use Shadow DOM for injected UI to prevent style leakage
Implement Edge-Cloud Continuum for dynamic resource allocation
Use 'safari-web-extension-converter' for macOS/iOS deployment
Maintain circular buffers for telemetry to optimize memory usage
Use ContextExtractor class with 5s cache for page metadata, content, and user selection
Implement Deep Research via Python REST API offloading
Use ServiceRegistry and MCPOrchestrator for backend tool management
